acceptance.status_reason: The per-family drain did exactly what it should on the REAL scheduled 12:15Z sweep: one invocation, no error and NO RETRIES, against OG-ap-11's three invocations on one RequestId all ending AccessDenied. The foreign record SURVIVED, proven positively because a receive RETURNED it. The own record was DRAINED, proven from the count plus the identity of the remainder -- depth 2 at plant, 1 after, and the single remaining message proven to be the foreign one -- deliberately not from a message failing to appear in a sample. THIS CRITERION WAS AMENDED: as first written it also required the records' presence in and absence from 'the schwab sweep's report', which does not exist for a scheduled sweep because the report is the function's discarded return value. I graded it FAIL as written, filed row Z-S100, and the issuer ruled (a) in A2 @d86203d41d that the report clause was its own criterion defect and that AC2 reads the queue.

mutant.description: Four controls, and the first is the strongest because it is a real prior failure of the same act. (1) OG-ap-11 IS THE NEGATIVE ARM: the identical build on the identical sweep, without this grant, failed three times on one RequestId with AccessDenied at schwab_runtime.py:319. So a clean run here cannot be a sweep that would pass regardless. (2) THE FOREIGN ARM: a record of another family was planted alongside, and must SURVIVE -- if the drain were still whole-queue it would be gone. (3) PRE-EXERCISE: both synthetic bodies were parsed by the DEPLOYED parser before being sent, so a malformed payload could not masquerade as a drain failure. (4) THE ISOLATED SIMULATE with one --resource-arns, since two in a call flip held actions to implicitDeny.
mutant.expected: The sweep completes with no error and no retries; the foreign record is still present afterwards; the own record is gone; and the simulate reads allowed where it read implicitDeny before the grant.
mutant.observed: One invocation 12:15:49Z to 12:18:19Z, RequestId 37fe3466, no traceback and no retry. Foreign eclipse f9a08314 returned by a post-sweep receive. Own schwab 44ee0375 gone, depth 2 to 1 with the remainder proven foreign. Simulate allowed, where the issuer's pre-cut read and the CTO half both recorded implicitDeny. Pre-exercise routed eclipse to 'eclipse' and schwab to 'schwab'.
